sloka: दृष्टा मे राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभी रक्षिता प्रमदावने ।। ५.६५.११ ।।।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭā me rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।rākṣasībhirvirūpābhī rakṣitā pramadāvane ।। 5.65.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "I found her in the beautiful garden guarded by hideous ogresses threatening her again and again৷৷
